mission.description: Fly from the base at (13267, 1987) to the destination at (18494, 17104). Maintain an altitude between 20 and 120 meters at every waypoint. Avoid all restricted zones and obstacles (Z1 [RAF Northolt (EGWU, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z2 [London Heathrow Airport (EGLL, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [London City Airport (EGLC, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m], Z4 [London Biggin Hill Airport (EGKB, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]), including the straight paths between waypoints. Keep the total horizontal route length at or below 151678 meters. (START is The Royal London Hospital Helipad; DEST is Metropolitan Police Air Support Unit Lippitts Hill.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
